description: 新北市固定式測速照相-板橋區 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新北市政府警察局. 新北市政府警察局所提供的固定測速照相主要提供欄位包含行政區、設置位置、速限、取締項目。 (板橋區). Coverage: 新北市政府警察局. The portal files it under the publisher 新北市政府警察局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-03-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
